current.responsive: Equal-width actions in one row; stack when scaled labels do not fit. Button height and internal text padding accommodate large text. Title/content can scroll while actions remain accessible.

appOwnedDialogs.behavior: Cancel/dismissal leaves wallet data unchanged. Confirm requests fresh wallet-bound device authentication when a device credential exists; no credential follows the approved no-auth policy. Deletion proceeds only after active-wallet identity, payment/preparation fences and native RGB audit pass.
appOwnedDialogs.paragraphLayout: Single continuous paragraph, including destination sentence.
appOwnedDialogs.contentActionsGapProof: The same shared 40 logical-pixel layout gap as App lock. 18 geometry tests cover both copies, original paragraph break, 1×/3× text, button-only and inherited caller Theme overrides.
appOwnedDialogs.authenticationOrdering: Keep prompt ownership until foreground both before and after the final device-security status reply. Ordinary prompt completion can arrive before Flutter lifecycle events; actual background and wallet/request changes still revoke the grant.
